sources.title: BMW Group Newsroom (Americas) - The BMW iX4

sources.title: BMW Group Newsroom (Americas) - The new BMW X5 and iX5

sources.title: BMW Group Newsroom (Americas) - The new BMW i3 (second model of the Neue Klasse)

sources.title: BMWBLOG - 2027 BMW i3 US pricing and specs
